name: OW4-1-the-light-half-of-a-ramp-starts-at-the-shadow
why: a swatch shade lands on our ramp by its light: middle to light in the light half

name: OW4-2-the-tip-is-taken-for-the-wide-end
why: a blade's axis runs from its base on the frame edge to its narrow tip

name: OW4-2b-a-held-blade-points-into-the-hand
why: a dagger's base is the end in the hand, whatever the frame edge cuts

name: OW4-3-a-shortened-blade-grows
old: const along = outAlong < lo ? outAlong : lo + (outAlong - lo) / stretch;
new: const along = outAlong < lo ? outAlong : lo + (outAlong - lo) * stretch;
why: the length scales the blade about its base

name: OW4-4-the-width-is-never-scaled
old: const across = mid + (Math.abs(off) <= edge * wide ? off / wide : off - Math.sign(off) * edge * (wide - 1));
why: a broad blade is widened about its centre line

name: OW4-5-no-blade-bends
old: const off = outAcross - mid - bend * share * share;
why: a curved blade bends toward its tip

name: OW4-6-the-chisel-cuts-nothing
why: the tanto's point is cut

name: OW4-7-the-fuller-covers-the-blade
why: the groove runs down the middle

name: OW4-8-the-war-axe-keeps-both-bits
why: our war axe is single-bitted

name: OW4-9-the-staff-is-ringed-from-its-foot
why: the rings are measured from the capped tip

name: OW4-10-the-fuller-is-not-shaded
why: a groove is shaded

name: OW4-11-the-item-mask-is-drawn
why: GetItemImage strips the mask (ChangeMask) before an icon is drawn

name: OW4-12-a-double-size-idle-past-record-0
why: Weapon Widget asks w_ for the idle alone; a strike falls through to the plain name

name: OW4-13-a-metal-that-is-not-one
why: a name is ours in MetalTypes' ten metals alone

name: OW4-14-an-icon-answers-a-silver-name
why: Silver is Unchanged: GetName leaves it bare, so no _Silver icon is ever asked

name: OW4-15-an-enchanted-weapon-built-from-the-plain-file
why: an enchanted weapon is drawn into the magic file's box (FPSWeapon.cs:398-399), so it is built from that file

name: OW4-16-the-bare-icon-in-another-law
why: the bare ask is a silver weapon's

name: OW4-17-our-set-answers-with-the-mod-off
why: the mod off is the classic frame, as DFU with the mod disabled

name: OW4-18-a-held-blade-redraws-the-hand
old: if (own && (!own[srcY * w + srcX] || out[y * w + x])) continue; // the hand stays Daggerfall's
why: the dagger's blade is redrawn behind the hand, never over it

name: OW4-19-the-pommel-counts-as-blade
old: if (!run || along - run.hi > 4) run = { lo: along, hi: along, n: 0 };
new: if (!run) run = { lo: along, hi: along, n: 0 };
why: metal past the fist is a pommel, no part of the blade

name: OW4-20-a-stab-toward-the-eye-is-reshaped
why: a blade seen end on has no length to shape: coloured only

name: OW4-21-a-glow-is-scaled-with-the-blade
old: const across = mid + (Math.abs(off) <= edge * wide ? off / wide : off - Math.sign(off) * edge * (wide - 1));
why: what hugs a widened blade moves out whole, so a thin line keeps its pixels together

name: OW4-22-the-axe-bit-read-off-the-screen
why: the bit is the haft's right read base to head, so an axe upside down keeps the same one

name: OW4-23-an-end-on-haft-read-as-lying
why: a stub of haft across the head's foot stands square to the wings' line

name: OW4-24-a-glow-taken-for-haft
why: the haft is its wood, never an enchantment's glow

name: OW4-25-a-stranded-pixel-stays
why: a piece of a line the nearest-pixel map broke goes

name: OW4-26-a-lone-spark-goes
why: a spark alone in the source stays alone
